name: Security
blurb: Defensive security for your own code: secure coding, threat models, Semgrep/CodeQL triage, dependencies, secrets and CI hardening.

tests.prompt: Add an endpoint that fetches a user-supplied image URL and stores a thumbnail.
tests.good: Allowlists scheme and host, resolves all DNS records and rejects private/link-local addresses, disables redirects, caps size and type, and adds an abuse-case test.

tests.prompt: Scan this repo with Semgrep and tell me what matters.
tests.good: Confirms the repo is the user's, agrees rulesets first, runs with metrics off via run-scans.sh, merges SARIF, confirms each finding in code and separates needs-verification items.

tests.prompt: Review our GitHub workflow that runs on pull_request_target and comments with an AI summary.
tests.good: Flags checkout of PR head with secrets, expressions in run blocks, unpinned actions and broad permissions; proposes split jobs, env indirection, SHA pins and a tool allowlist.
